component.name: ArchVerse Overlay
component.summary: Community Linux companion overlay for Star Citizen

description.p: ArchVerse Overlay is a community Linux port of SubliminalsTV's Star Citizen overlay. It provides mission and blueprint tracking, the Resource Scanner, chat and party tools, payout scanning, OCR-assisted widgets, and configurable transparent HUD panels.
This Flatpak build packages the Linux runtime and application dependencies so it does not depend on Arch, Fedora, Debian, or Ubuntu-specific Electron, Node.js, OCR, or X11 utility packages.
ArchVerse Overlay is a community port and is not an official Cloud Imperium Games product.
Second distribution-neutral Flatpak field-test with dynamic desktop canvas sizing, host-prefix discovery, and a conservative Flatpak renderer policy.
